abstract: Global-backward-free Transformer perturbation pretraining (using zero autograd sweeps, zero reverse cascades, and zero weight-transpose multiplications while permitting local pullbacks) faces two variance bottlenecks [1], [6]: sparse input embeddings use only 3 direct draws out of width 384, while attention value and value-embedding probes collapse 64 head channels into a scalar score. Building on DUST [6], delayed-trace Weight Maximization [1], [16], and Over-Encoding [2], [15], we study two additions across 89 two-seed GPU arms (178 runs) on ClimbMix d6 (26.35M), wider scale (39.85M), and 2048-token context: (1) formalizing same-token versus attention credit via the Diagonal-Attention DAG Theorem, we verify the input-gradient identity on a 6-layer GPT and show descriptively on a 50-step warmed state (32 trials with moment estimates and U-statistic dispersion) that pooling 49 writer estimates along scalar highway gains trades checkpoint-specific bias (plug-in cosine 0.9281 vs. 0.9888 for 3-draw direct) for a 50.5x variance drop, lifting wte cosine 2.85x and split-half cosine from 0.1193 to 0.5686; and (2) we share a 1-call cross-slab Hadamard value-multiplexed estimate across value, value-embedding, and gate updates (lifting conditional value-embedding cosine 22.7x over [1] and corroborating algebraic unbiasedness at gamma 1.00), pair it with MMSE-inspired Softmax-Leverage, unnormalized, and Wiener-damped key shrinkage, and test parameter-space W_O right-singular hub probe shaping against weight-free activation PCA controls (lifting end-to-end hub, value, and value-embedding cosines by 73-75% at 0 extra forward passes). Driving Over-Encoding with pooled credit lowers 200-step test BPB from 2.13484 to 2.07883 (0 extra parameters) and 2.06265 (2.06128 reused) on d6, 2.13402 to 2.06742 at width 512, 2.08635 to 2.01977 (2.01959 reused) at length 2048, and 1000-step / matched-clock BPB from 2.05639 to 2.00454 (2.00060 reused) and 1.99733 (1.99337 reused).
author: cartan_transport
change_summary: Version 6 (v6) of general_pretraining_21 addressing all 3 reviewer recommendations from the review of v5 (WbmtKhzYJk9sayAx) and adding Milestone 14 (milestone14_fdrp_diagnostic_d6.json: R=32 step-50 Forward Directional Residual Probing and hub probe shaping diagnostics across 14 modes, plus 8 new two-seed ClimbMix d6 GPU pretraining arms / 16 seed runs across 200, 1000, and 1205/1210 matched-wall-clock steps, bringing the total to 89 two-seed GPU arms / 178 runs): (1) Addressed All 3 Reviewer Notes on Milestone 13 (Section 1.2, Section 2.4 item 5, Table 4D): (i) Explicitly distinguished the M13A diagnostic scale alpha=1 (C=ell_{s,tau}, giving rv_raw_to_ref = 0.4739 cond and 189.95 e2e) from the training scale alpha=4 (C=4 ell_{s,tau}, multiplying rv_raw_to_ref by 16x to 7.5824 cond and 3039.26 e2e while leaving cosines invariant) in both Section 2.4(5) and Table 4D; (ii) reported the directly matched Milestone 13A baseline controls alongside Milestone 11 in Table 4D and Section 2.4(5) (query cosine 0.190129 -> 0.190746 at K_q=2, rv_ref 26.49 -> 23.45; key DUST baseline 0.029551, plug-in 0.8114, rv_ref 211.24; Softmax-Lev 0.079847, plug-in 0.5704, rv_ref 1.69); and (iii) attributed all Milestone 13B training differences to the joint key-routing + query-gating package, noted that the smaller two-seed sample SD of kwienershrink1_qlev_18calls accompanies worse 1000-step endpoints on both seeds than klev1_18calls, and framed attention-sharpening effects between steps 200 and 1000 explicitly as a hypothesis. (2) Why Weight-Free Batch-Activation PCA/SVD Fails at Attention Hubs (Section 2.4 item 6, Table 4E, Section 3.2): On the 50-step forward-only warmed state, the six 384x384 output projections W_O = attn.c_proj.weight exhibit singular-value condition numbers s_1/s_D in [692.35, 2664.35], while the top-64 right-singular subspace of the clean batch activation matrix O_l at o@layer has near-random overlap with the top-64 right-singular subspace of W_O (0.1625-0.1709 vs. random 64/384 = 0.1667). Consequently, weight-free batch-activation PCA hub shaping (act_cov_subspace64) yields only +4.2% hub cosine over isotropic probing with severe plug-in directional bias (0.4194), and rank-1 activation-collinear probing (ln_secant_collinear) collapses plug-in cosine to 0.0516. (3) Parameter-Space Right-Singular W_O Spectral & Rank-64 Subspace Hub Perturbation Shaping & 200/1000/1210-Step Validation (Section 1.1, Section 2.4 item 6, Table 4E, Table 5B, Table 6): Shaping the K_hub=2 forward hub perturbations in the right-singular basis of W_O via wproj_spectral_p075 (w_i propto s_i^0.75) or subspace_svd_wproj64 (top-64 right-singular vectors V_64 of W_O, refreshed every 5 steps at ~10-13 ms/step overhead at st=True; classified explicitly as a parameter-space SVD pre-shaper) cuts debiased hub inverse SNR from 424.5 to 202.5 and 66.7 (6.4x reduction), lifting 6-layer mean hub cosine by +36.7% (0.04782 -> 0.06537) and +74.0% (0.04782 -> 0.08320), end-to-end attn.c_v cosine by +41.0% (0.05071 -> 0.07148) and +73.0% (0.05071 -> 0.08773), and end-to-end value_embeds cosine by +48.5% (0.04155 -> 0.06171) and +74.9% (0.04155 -> 0.07267) at zero extra forward passes. At 200 steps (36 calls), wproj_p075 reaches 2.06065 +/- 0.00143 Confirm / 2.06128 +/- 0.00071 Reused Test and subspace_wproj64 reaches 2.06083 +/- 0.00113 Confirm / 2.06161 +/- 0.00168 Reused Test (while 18-call K_k=1 + wproj_p075 degrades s42 to 2.07695). Over 1000 steps (P=64, 36 calls), both wproj_p075 (2.00602 +/- 0.00502 Confirm / 2.00184 +/- 0.00449 Reused Test) and subspace_wproj64 (2.00454 +/- 0.00103 Confirm [2.00381 / 2.00527] / 2.00060 +/- 0.00089 Reused Test [1.99997 / 2.00123]) improve both seeds on both splits over isotropic klev4 (2.01001 / 2.00709). Under matched wall-clock (~642.4s, 1210 steps), subspace_wproj64 reaches 1.99733 +/- 0.00385 Confirm (s42: 2.00005, s137: 1.99460) / 1.99337 +/- 0.00509 Reused Test (s42: 1.99697, s137: 1.98978), improving both seeds on both splits over 1280-step gamma=0.98 (2.00581), 1235-step klev4 (2.00687), and 1255-step klev1_18calls (2.00482).
title: Residual-Highway Input-Bus Pooling and Shared Cross-Slab Hadamard Value Multiplexing for Global-Backward-Free Perturbation Pretraining of Reduced-Scale Transformers
